7851638095908.title: 3D Drawing Pen Art for Kids
7851638095908.description:
Description

The 3D pen is a new direction in the creative development of children. This is a technical device for creating 3D drawings. Outwardly, the device looks like an ordinary handle. But instead of ink, it is filled with colored plastic. At high temperatures, the plastic rod turns into a liquid substance for drawing.

Using a 3D pen, you can draw individual elements on paper or any flat surface, then connecting them into a complex model. Hardened plastic is easy to remove from the work surface. Drawing with a 3D pen develops abstract, logical and spatial thinking, fine motor skills and realizes creative potential.

Features:
  • Original design;
  • Ability to paint with PCL plastic;
  • Adjustable speed and temperature;
  • Lightweight body - the handle is lightweight, it fits comfortably in the hand and it is convenient and easy to draw with it;
  • Sleep mode function - after 5 minutes of idleness, it automatically switches to sleep mode.
Specifications:
Included:
  • Type: 3D pen.
  • Power type: battery.
  • Recommended age: 3+
  • Material: plastic.
  • Type of filament used (plastic): PCL;
  • Handle length: 19 cm.

  • USB cord,
  • PCL plastic - 5 pcs.
Package size: 21x11x6 cm

7883563696164.title: Adorable Food Grade Silicone Baby Tableware Set
7883563696164.description:
Make mealtime fun, safe, and mess-free with this adorable Silicone Baby Tableware Set! Crafted from high-quality food-grade silicone, this set is not only super cute but also safe for your little one's sensitive gums and growing appetite. The set brings joy to every bite, while the soft, flexible design ensures comfort and easy handling for tiny hands.

Whether you’re feeding at home or on the go, this set is heat-resistant, easy to clean, and sterilizable, making it a must-have for modern parents. BPA-free, dishwasher-safe, and designed to handle temperatures from -20°C to 220°C, this tableware set is ready for any feeding challenge!

Features:

  • 🐣 Cute Design – Makes mealtime playful and engaging

  • 🧼 Food-Grade Silicone – 100% safe, BPA-free, soft and flexible

  • ♨️ Heat Resistant – Withstands from -20°C to 220°C

  • 🧽 Easy to Clean – Dishwasher safe and stain resistant

  • 🧴 Disinfection Friendly – Can be sterilized via boiling or UV (recommended max time: 5 minutes)

  • 🍴 Complete Set Includes – Plate, bowl, spoon, fork, sippy cup, spill-proof lid & bib

  • 🍼 Perfect for Weaning & Self-Feeding – Gentle on gums and encourages independence

  • Box size: H"10, W"12.5 inches

Give your baby a safe, stylish, and joyful start to self-feeding with this Silicone Duck Tableware Set — where functionality meets fun!

7719214383140.title: Baby Soap Elephant | Blue
7719214383140.description:

INGREDIENTS:

  • Lather the soap on wet hands, then gently apply it to wet skin.

  • For external use only Avoid contact with eyes Discontinue using the product in case of any irritation and discomfort Store in a cool and dry place and avoid placing it under direct sunlight.
  • Pack Size: 6x4 Inches
